sample_prompts: This image shows a segment of a Mandelbrot fractal with spiraling blue and green patterns against a deep purple-blue background. The fractal arms radiate from a central spiral, resembling frost or cosmic swirls. Miniature black Mandelbrot sets dot the fractal, highlighted by sharp yellow edges. The glowing blue-to-green gradient of the fractal contrasts vividly with the darker backdrop, creating a sense of depth and movement. The overall effect is both organic and otherworldly.
